heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can I manage content myself?
items.answer: Yes. WordPress is built so non-technical teams can edit pages, posts and products.

items.question: Will my WordPress site be secure?
items.answer: We follow security best practices, keep it updated and offer maintenance plans.

items.question: Can you migrate my existing site?
items.answer: Yes. We migrate content and design while protecting your SEO.

items.question: How long does wordpress development take?
items.answer: A business website usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while custom web applications take 3 to 6 months depending on features and integrations.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
